svg.title: Ableton Push 2 — orthographic interactive controller, LEDs off
svg.desc: Hand-coded vector reconstruction from the two supplied photographs. Device body ratio 1420:1142. Additional canvas height accommodates the attached rear USB and 12 V power cables. No embedded bitmap. Each physical control has a stable group ID, a base shape, and a separate LED element with fill-opacity zero. All shadows are in the shadows layer; labels and glass are separate. Coordinates within device-space follow the front-on reference photograph.
